decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed ticket office is considered to be in keeping with the street scene and the proposed pedestrian entrance is considered to provide satisfactory access for all users. This is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV.B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for people with disabilities) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Removal of existing metal gates and the erection of a single storey ticket office and new metal crowd barrier to existing site.
